```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
```


```{r}
# This project looks at RNA-seq data for selected genes. The gene chosen was
# RBM5, and CFLAR was chosen as the second gene for comparison. Summary
# statistics and some visualizations are used to examine the gene expression
# data. Tissue type is used as a covariate to compare RBM5 expression
# between tumor and normal samples.

setwd("/Users/simoner/Downloads/Foundations_DS")

# loads in the count matrix and metadata
counts <- read.csv("counts.csv", row.names = 1)
metadata <-  read.csv("meta_data.csv", row.names = 1)
```

```{r}
# selects RBM5 as the primary gene, and CFLAR as the second gene
gene1 <- "ENSG00000003756.17"
gene2 <- "ENSG00000003402.20"
```
```{r}
# this extracts the RBM5 count data
rbm5 <- as.numeric(counts[gene1, ])

# generates summary statistics
summary(rbm5)
sd(rbm5)
```

```{r}
# extracts the CFLAR count data
cflar <- as.numeric(counts[gene2, ])

# generates summary statistics for second gene
summary(cflar)
sd(cflar)
```

```{r}

# creates a histogram to show distribution of RBM5 counts
ggplot(data.frame(rbm5), aes(x = rbm5)) + geom_histogram(
  fill = "steelblue",
  color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of RBM5",
    x = "RBM5 Expression Counts",
    y = "Frequency"
  )
```
```{r}
# creates a scatter plot to compare the two genes
ggplot(data.frame(rbm5, cflar), aes(x = rbm5, y = cflar)) + 
  geom_point(color = "steelblue",
             alpha = 0.35) +
  labs(
    title = "RBM5 and CFLAR Expression",
    x = "RBM5 Expression Counts",
    y = "CFLAR Expression Counts"
  )
```
```{r}
# combines RBM5 counts with tissue type covariate
gene_data <- data.frame(
  rbm5 = rbm5,
  tissue_type = metadata$tissue_type
)

# creates a violin plot to compare RBM5 counts by tissue type
ggplot(gene_data, aes(x = tissue_type, y = rbm5, fill = tissue_type)) + 
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6) + geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    alpha = 0.35,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Tumor" = "purple3",
    "Normal" = "Lightblue"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "RBM5 Expression by Tissue Type",
    x = "Tissue Type",
    y = "RBM5 Counts"
  ) + theme(legend.position = "none")
```
```{r}
#creates a box plot to compare RBM5 counts
ggplot(gene_data, aes(x = tissue_type, y = rbm5, fill = tissue_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Tumor" = "thistle2",
    "Normal" = "royalblue3"
    )) +
  labs(
    title = "RBM5 Expression by Tissue Type",
    x = "Tissue Type",
    y = "RBM5 Expression Counts"
  ) + theme(legend.position = "none")

```

```{r}
# selects 10 genes and creates smaller matrix with selected genes
heatmap_genes <- rownames(counts)[1:10]

heatmap_genes

heatmap_data <- counts[heatmap_genes, ]
```


```{r}
# creates an annotation bar showing tissue type
annotation_bar <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  tissue_type = metadata$tissue_type,
  col = list(
      tissue_type = c(
        "Normal" = "lightpink",
        "Tumor" = "honeydew2"
      )
  )
)

# creates a heatmap with the 10 selected genes with tissue type as an
# annotation bar
Heatmap(
  heatmap_data,
  name = "Counts",
  top_annotation = annotation_bar,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_title = "Genes",
  column_title = "Samples"
)
```
```{r}
# creates a CDF plot to compare RBM5 expression counts by tissue type
ggplot(gene_data, aes(x = rbm5, color = tissue_type)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "step") +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Distribution of RBM5 by Tissue Type",
    x = "RBM5 Expression Counts",
    y = "Cumulative Probability",
    color = "Tissue Type"
  )
```
